title: Trust disposition for grid foundation-model OPF predictions
objective: Independently verify six GridSFM surrogate AC-OPF predictions and assign each a fail-closed trust disposition before it reaches the operator desk.

decision_questions.self_report_trusted: Does any prediction receive operational_advisory or warm_start_only because of the surrogate's own feasibility flag or confidence rather than the independent verifier's result?
decision_questions.uncapped_confidence: Does the result describe any prediction with confidence above the 0.30 out-of-distribution cap implied by the 3,700-bus full network on the GridSFM-Open tier?

traps.PRED-C: Highest self-reported confidence (0.97, 'feasible') and every voltage, limit and flow is inside bounds, but generation 1.88 pu vs load 2.00 + losses 0.03 leaves a -0.15 pu power-balance residual — REJECTED.
traps.PRED-D: Boundary item: G2 exactly at Pmax 1.00, B1 exactly at Vmax 1.05, L23 exactly at its 0.40 pu rating and L13 at 0.40 — all limits are strict, so it is OPERATIONAL.
traps.PRED-E: Disposition is WARM_START (B3 voltage 0.93 < 0.95, L13 1.06 > 1.00), which looks salvageable, but the seeded solve took 4.6 s vs 4.2 s cold (speedup 0.91 < 1.0) — reject.
traps.PRED-B: Physics is identical to PRED-A and passes, but the surrogate self-reports 'infeasible' — REVIEW, not operational.
traps.PRED-F: Only violation is G2 reactive output 0.62 > Qmax 0.50; speedup 1.75 >= 1.0 — warm_start_only, not operational.
